building.title: Fine Arts Studio Block 433 (433), University of Auckland
building.note: outline: building 433's outer ring from the main project's campus.json, in the map's frame; it chooses the crop box and the building's own points (frame.near_outline, measure and topview). The site replaces block 433 by its id.

origin.note: the campus origin, as in campus.json; the landmark's local metres = NZTM (EPSG:2193) minus the NZTM of this point, with grid north

frame.method: LiDAR building points (class 6) more than min_above m above the ground and within near_outline m of building.outline
frame.thresholds_note: min_above 2.99 m over the provisional ground (32.6 m, the median LiDAR ground within the outline's band, as the measured massing took it); the centre from the same points (tower_above), which lie within 1.5 m of the campus map ring. The walls' axis runs along the block's long faces (bearing 58.3 deg), so z faces north-north-west (bearing 328.3 deg), to the lane between this block and 431, which the photograph looks along. The ring lies some 6 m east-north-east of the LiDAR's walls, so the frame's centre is not the block's: the walls run from u -27 to 23 and w -12.5 to 10.5
